status: provisional abstract design; independent cryptography review pending
objective: Reduce strict B2 lockout after bounded state divergence without reopening compromised or replayed state.

mandatory.requirement: Use an established cryptographic core; T1 adds recovery control and state management only.
Bind every recovery message to spacecraft identity, recovery ID, target or proposed epoch, monotonic counter, transcript, authorized authority, and candidate reference when one exists.
Use two-phase activation or equivalent confirmation so candidate state cannot authorize normal commands.
Retain at most N pending candidates and activation receipts for at most H contact windows; N and H are experiment parameters.
Never automatically reactivate a lower epoch or key marked compromised.
Require a fresh post-recovery command and authenticated telemetry exchange before SUCCESS.
Define deterministic behavior for loss of prepare, response, commit, confirmation, test-command, and status messages.
Every attempt terminates in exactly one defined outcome class.
Bound denial-of-service cost from repeated recovery triggers, cache exhaustion, conflicting attempts, and replay floods.
Produce independent ground, spacecraft, recovery-authority, and evidence-service records.
State the finite passive-adversary interval and bounded-delivery condition required for any later PCS claim.
Report security and availability separately, not as a hidden composite score.
No transition may depend on simulator-only knowledge of the peer epoch; the spacecraft selects a forward target and returns it in RECOVERY_RESPONSE.
Permit retransmission only when the recovery binding is exact; reject conflicting bindings and duplicate message identifiers without operational state change.
Use a recovery-authority counter and epoch floor that survive endpoint rollback and are independent of the active operational traffic key.
Retain at most one bounded spacecraft activation receipt so an exact commit retry can re-emit confirmation without a second activation.
Classify confirmation-budget exhaustion after spacecraft activation as SECURE_DEGRADED unless the model proves that no authorized recovery transition remains.

provisional_selected_controls: strict expiry and monotonic recovery-authority counters
prohibited_shortcuts: fallback to a prior compromised epoch
treating candidate generation or endpoint convergence as recovery completion
using simulator-only peer state as an activation or epoch-selection oracle
importing unrelated one-message stateless recovery designs
external_review_mandatory_before: manuscript submission or external security claims
